about: Known-answer eval cases for the Agentic Investigator (verdict/investigate.py). Each case is run through the REAL agentic loop (live PubMed + Cellosaurus). Positives: a real antibody with published genetic validation (expect FOUND_VALIDATION) or a real misidentified line with Cellosaurus provenance (expect PROVENANCE_CHAIN); negatives: an epitope-tag antibody for which in-study genetic validation does not apply (expect NO_VALIDATION_FOUND). `expect_id`, when given, is a real record that SHOULD appear among the grounded citations. All citations are deterministically verified against actual retrieval, so a cited id is real by construction.
